description: Dandot Cement Company Limited was incorporated in 1980 and began production in 1983, when Pakistan's cement sector was state-owned under the State Cement Corporation. Its plant, installed in 1982 and supplied and erected by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries of Japan, was designed for 1,000 tonnes of clinker a day and was later optimised by FLSmidth of Denmark to 1,600 tonnes a day. The company passed through the Chakwal Group, Gharibwal Cement and the Three Star Group, and has since been acquired by Calicom Industries (Private) Limited. It produces ordinary Portland grey cement and sells it nationwide through dealers and distributors.
headOffice: 5-Zafar Ali Road, Gulberg V, Lahore, Pakistan
